Motion to accept the consent agenda items A - N
Motion to appoint Teresa Taylor Tate as City Attorney

Motion to ADOPT Ordinance 8504 changing licensing requirements for Marijuana Keyholders, Circuses, Carnivals and Menageries, Mobile Food Vehicles, Itinerant Merchants, Tobacco Retailers, and Secondhand Dealers and Pawnbrokers by amending Title 4, “Licenses and Permits,” Sections 6-14-8, “Requirements Related to Operation of Medical Marijuana Businesses,” 6-16-8, “Requirements Related to Operation of Recreational Marijuana Businesses,” and 9-6-6, “Mobile Food Vehicle Sales,” B.R.C. 1981

Motion to ADOPT Ordinance 8505 the budget for the City of Boulder, Colorado, for the fiscal year commencing on the first day of January 2022 and ending on the last day of December 2022; ADOPT Ordinance 8506 establishing the 2021 City of Boulder property tax mill levies which are to be collected by the County of Boulder, State of Colorado, within the City of Boulder in 2022 for payment of expenditures by the City of Boulder, County of Boulder, State of Colorado; ADOPT Ordinance 8507 appropriating money to defray expenses and liabilities of the City of Boulder, Colorado, for the 2022 fiscal year of the City of Boulder, commencing on the first day of January 2022 and ending on the last day of December 2022; ADOPT Ordinance 8508 amending Chapter 4-20, “Fees,” and Section 3-8-3, “Tax Imposed on Nonresidential and Residential Development,” B.R.C. 1981, changing fees

Move to AMEND on second reading the title of Ordinance 8512 to read Ordinance 8512 granting authority to the approving authority under Title 9, “Land Use Code,” B.R.C. 1981, to approve a development that DOES NOT MEET the minimum open space per dwelling unit standards for a property in the Business Community 1 district (BC-1) located at 3320 28 th Street, at Diagonal Plaza, authorizing the city manager to execute documents that will secure affordable housing on the property and Move to ADOPT 8512 with such title amendment
There being no further business to come before Council at this time, by motion regularly adopted, the meeting was adjourned by Mayor Weaver at 9:31 p.m.
